column1: # Pascal Validation Suite 5.7 -- (C) Copyright 1982, British Standards Institution
# What this compiler does with each of the 812 programs, and the category it is
# in. tests/bsi/run.sh fails on ANY difference, in either direction: a program
# that starts passing means this catalogue has stopped describing the compiler,
# which is verify/'s rule for a KNOWN_GAP that begins to hold (ADR-0013).
# Update an entry only in the change that moved it, and say which clause did.
# Running the suite is not a validation -- see tests/bsi/README.md for BSI's
# three conditions, one of which is that results describe the whole suite.
# Each ERROR test carries the Annex D number it names, so the list of errors
# this processor does not report -- which clause 5.1 f) 1) requires
# doc/implementation-defined.md to publish -- is data here rather than prose
